prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[goal]
Write the June incident report to ./result.json with start, end, duration, availability, SLO verdict, and root cause.

[action]
Read the three June logs and README. Located the incident by searching every log for save errors, watchdog lines, and "server ready"; computed duration and availability; wrote and re-parsed result.json. No browser tabs, windows, or apps were opened, so nothing needed closing.

[result]
Assumptions: log timestamps are used as recorded (no timezone metadata to convert); "first save error" means the first `ERROR SaveGame failed`, per README's down definition (first save error to `server ready`); June = 30 days = 43,200 minutes; only one incident, as README states; durations kept as decimal minutes.

Evidence, from logs/gameserver-2026-06-02.log:
- L241 `03:10:02 WARN disk /data usage 97% (free 3.1 GB)`
- L251 `03:17:42 ERROR SaveGame failed: ... No space left on device` (first save error, start)
- L253 `03:18:05 FATAL watchdog: server unresponsive for 20s, restarting`; L254-293 restart loop, exit code 137
- L292 `03:52:10 INFO backup rotation freed 38.2 GB on /data`
- L294 `03:53:31 INFO server ready, accepting players` (end)

Values: start 2026-06-02T03:17:42, end 2026-06-02T03:53:31, 2,149 s = 35.8167 min. June availability (43,200 - 35.8167)/43,200 = 99.9171%. SLO 99.9% allows 43.2 min down, so slo_999_ok = true. Root cause: /data disk exhaustion from unrotated backups; save writes failed, watchdog restart loop kept failing until backup rotation freed space. The June 1 RCON auth failure was unrelated.

[next]
File is complete at <WORKSPACE>\result.json; ready for the team.

Backup rotation freed 38.2 GB at 03:52:10, after which the server came back and reported ready at 03:53:31. Root cause: disk exhaustion on /data from unrotated backups, not the RCON auth failure on June 1."
}
